description: Replaces the entire canvas with one of the built-in verified diagrams, by id from get_templates. The template carries its topology, parameters and simulation settings. Returns the block and connection counts, the verified simulation settings, and the attribution when the model is based on third-party material. This is a destructive action that asks the user for approval in the BlockWerk tab.

templateId.description: Template id from get_templates, e.g. "inverted_pendulum" or "pid_loop".

name: load_template
title: Load diagram template
